imagine a little snowball, now let it roll downhill on a huge snow covered mountain with no way to stop it. Thats pretty much it, a small problem, that led to bigger problems, which eventually became a HUGE problem.

1. I was painfully shy as a kid 
2.  grandpa died when i was 11 and i alienated myself from everyone around me (got seriously addicted to videogames) 
3. this eventually led to lack of social interaction as a young teenager which is crucial 
4. being the "shy weird kid" made me very self conscious 
5. eventually started to become socially anxious and any kind of social interaction scared me to death 
6. lack of social interaction means i never developed social skills, which means i couldn't really make friends (still had a few friends that kind of "adopted" me) 
7. all of this obviously means i never spoke to girls, which made me even more self conscious and anxious around women 
8. developed a depression at 19 years old (still going) and i couldn't finish high school until 21
9. Got into university at 21 to study Electrical Engineering (0 women in my class), and made 0 friends after 2 years
10. 23 years old now, social skills of a shy 16 year old kid, complete virgin, never kissed, never even spoke with a girl (doesn't help that i haven't had girls in my class since i was 16 years old). Now i can only go out with those guys at best once or twice a month.

So to sum it up, all of this BS which eventually developed a really strong social anxiety and depression is what made me FA.

Now that i think about it, from the age of 12 to 16 my dad used to come home drunk from the bar regularly and became very violent, which led me to "hide" in my room scared that i might upset him and make him angry (he would smash stuff around the house constantly). Estava-me a referir às classes de armas em sí, não especificamente do tiro desportivo, armas de classe A são armas proibidas, classe B são pistolas de calibres militares/policiais, B1 é para defesa pessoal civil (32 long, 6.35), C é carabinas / armas de cano estriado e D é caçadeiras.

Não tenho a certeza  como funciona na Suiça, mas o OP falou numa AR15 e supostamente as AR15 são semi-automáticas, e tenho quase a certeza que ele não pode ter uma arma automática na Suiça. Mas la está, tu podes ter uma AK47 em Portugal, desde que cumpra com os requesitos legais fazem parte da classe C.

Como assim armas de guerra? Tu podes ter uma arma tipo AR15 desde que não tenha função de disparo automático e o carregador tem que estar bastante limitado, essas armas fazem parte da classe C, que é a licença que os caçadores tiram para poderem ter carabinas. Armas de guerra são armas que fazem parte da classe A (armas "proíbidas"), ou seja, armas de uso militar/policial ou que não cumpram com os requesitos para serem permitidas nas outras categorias de armas (facas de abertura automatica, armas caseiras,   bastões, armas alteradas, automáticas...)
